{
  "decisions": [
    {
      "chunk_id": "U0031",
      "include": true,
      "question_ids": [
        "5B.1",

        "5B.4",
        "5B.6",
        "5B.8",
        "5B.10"
      ],
      "relevance": "Concrete campaign-policy package: proposed financing through public-sector austerity savings estimated at 100 billion pesos in the first year and more effective tax collection; expanded public services and social programs for older people, unemployed people, and single mothers; support for agriculture, tourism, and public works; organizational-efficiency reform without Pemex privatization; a constitutional fair-wage commitment; and proposed NAFTA changes protecting domestic agricultural producers.",
      "adjacent_context": "The preceding campaign context may be needed to establish the date, electoral platform, and whether these were proposals rather than enacted measures; this chunk itself clearly attributes the package to a prospective PRD government.",
      "exclusion_reason": null
    },
    {
      "chunk_id": "U0032",
      "include": false,
      "question_ids": [],
      "relevance": "No material Chapter 5B evidence.",
      "adjacent_context": "Its discussion of alleged Chávez links and the PRD's distance from Venezuelan state direction could contextualize ideology, but supplies no concrete economic action, implementation finding, or outcome. The remainder concerns polling and preliminary election results.",
      "exclusion_reason": "Political-association claims, campaign polling, and election-result chronology do not independently establish an economic policy action, cost, measured outcome, implementation finding, method, qualification, attribution fact, or contrary finding for a 5B lens."
    },
    {
      "chunk_id": "U0033",
      "include": false,
      "question_ids": [],
      "relevance": "No material Chapter 5B evidence.",
      "adjacent_context": "May be relevant to the broader 2006 electoral dispute but is unnecessary for interpreting any included economic evidence.",
      "exclusion_reason": "The chunk exclusively reports election counts, fraud allegations, observer conclusions, and litigation plans; it contains no qualifying economic-governance evidence."
    },
    {
      "chunk_id": "U0034",
      "include": false,
      "question_ids": [],
      "relevance": "No material Chapter 5B evidence.",
      "adjacent_context": "Provides institutional and political context for López Obrador's post-election opposition strategy, not for an economic action or result.",
      "exclusion_reason": "Election-monitor findings, legislative seat totals, demonstrations, rhetoric, and civil-disobedience plans are outside the supplied economic-wellbeing lenses and contain no independently material economic evidence."
    },
    {
      "chunk_id": "U0035",
      "include": false,
      "question_ids": [],
      "relevance": "No material Chapter 5B evidence.",
      "adjacent_context": "Continues the election-dispute chronology and may explain López Obrador's later opposition status.",
      "exclusion_reason": "Judicial recount decisions, vote adjustments, resistance calls, and negotiations over congressional leadership do not provide a concrete economic policy, economic outcome, implementation finding, or relevant qualification."
    },
    {
      "chunk_id": "U0036",
      "include": false,
      "question_ids": [],
      "relevance": "No material Chapter 5B evidence.",
      "adjacent_context": "Establishes that López Obrador created a symbolic alternative government after the 2006 election, which may help interpret subsequent opposition activities.",
      "exclusion_reason": "The alternative-government formation and anti-corruption rhetoric are political events without a concrete competition, procurement, disclosure, audit, enforcement, remedial, or other economic-governance action meeting the evidence threshold."
    },
    {
      "chunk_id": "U0037",
      "include": false,
      "question_ids": [],
      "relevance": "No material Chapter 5B evidence.",
      "adjacent_context": "The planned national tour and alternative program may precede later policy details, but none are stated here.",
      "exclusion_reason": "Personal biography, a legally symbolic inauguration, travel plans, and protest plans contain no concrete economic policy content, cost, result, or implementation evidence."
    },
    {
      "chunk_id": "U0038",
      "include": false,
      "question_ids": [],
      "relevance": "No material Chapter 5B evidence.",
      "adjacent_context": "Explains the confrontational political environment and López Obrador's lack of executive authority during this period.",
      "exclusion_reason": "The presidential inauguration conflict, demonstrations, political rhetoric, and book preparation do not independently provide economic-policy or economic-performance evidence."
    },
    {
      "chunk_id": "U0039",
      "include": false,
      "question_ids": [],
      "relevance": "No material Chapter 5B evidence.",
      "adjacent_context": "The explicit absence of an executive or legislative mandate is useful background when interpreting policy advocacy in adjacent chunks, but is not itself evidence of economic governance.",
      "exclusion_reason": "Opposition activism, documentary production, internal-party disagreement, and the declining political effectiveness of the parallel presidency contain no concrete economic action, measured outcome, cost, distributional result, or economic implementation finding."
    },
    {
      "chunk_id": "U0040",
      "include": true,
      "question_ids": [
        "5B.1",
        "5B.3",
        "5B.4",
        "5B.6",
        "5B.7",
        "5B.10"
      ],
      "relevance": "Concrete energy-policy dispute with an economic diagnosis and contrary assessments: the PAN government pursued reform in response to declining national oil revenue caused by rapidly falling crude production; commentators characterized the reform as timid and insufficient; López Obrador opposed it as opening Pemex and national petroleum management to privatization and foreign firms, launched the National Movement in Defense of Petroleum in January 2008, and organized a July consultation involving one million participants.",
      "adjacent_context": "U0039 is useful to establish that López Obrador lacked executive and legislative office and therefore acted as an opposition leader; U0040 itself also locates the advocacy within legislative politics. Details of the reform's provisions, adoption, execution, and measured effects would be needed before treating this as evidence of implemented policy or outcomes.",
      "exclusion_reason": null
    }
  ]
}
